status_note: Twelve projections (arch lookup/min/identity, lanedMap lifecycle, PIECE and MULTIEQUAL splits through doTrace+apply, INT_MULT zero-mutation rejection, SUBPIECE terminator with allowSubpieceTerminator, STORE/LOAD lane splits with INT_ADD pointer advancement, INT_RIGHT/INT_LEFT lane-to-lane copying with zero-fill lanes, INT_ZEXT half-register extension, INDIRECT lane splits with shared iop annotations, restricted skipLanes>0 windows through SUBPIECE restriction/extension, and the typelock metatype gate rejecting INT and STRUCT while admitting ARRAY) are byte-identical MATCH against the locked 12.0.4 oracle. TRANSFORM-CONSTANT-IOP-SPACE-0001 is resolved: TransformVar::createReplacement's constant_iop arm now resolves the affecting op from the placeholder value (offset-based getOpFromConst mirroring op.hh:249/transform.cc:213) and re-materializes the annotation via Funcdata::new_varnode_iop as an iop-space varnode (transform.cc:211-215); the INDIRECT slot-1 projection was de-normalized so both sides are byte-compared through the true iop-space classification, and the de-normalized run reproduced the pinned golden hashes unchanged. subflow.cc:3942 stays NO_ORACLE (undefined behavior in the oracle itself). 2026-08-24 repin: base moved from a52d3e3 to 4599b5011c87129e3e6bb83a63f9cff6b0d00118 (overlay sha256 values refreshed; overlays are now byte-equal to the pinned base files), the runner resolves libbfd-2.38-system.so from the unpacked BFD package path with an embedded rpath, and a full bilateral rebuild against the locked oracle reproduced every pinned golden hash unchanged (ghidra stdout sha256 == rugra stdout sha256 == 9e7a670accdfad1a2610a3e4304bdbda684767cb3eac10855293913ce14dc6de, both stderrs empty, diff exit 0, fixture exit codes 0/0). Residual set unchanged and not shrunk: LANEDIVIDE-INFRA-RESIDUAL-0001 remains NO_ORACLE. Fixture-level B2 status: MATCH.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: setReplacement returns the pieceMap array start of the first split for a varnode (marked varnodes reuse the existing array, ignoring the requested subset, subflow.cc:3521-3522) and rejects type-locked varnodes whose metatype is above TYPE_ARRAY or is TYPE_STRUCT/TYPE_UNION (subflow.cc:3532-3538); getLanedRegister returns a const LanedRegister* shared by pointer identity into lanedMap (Rugra Arc identity); doTrace/apply mutate Funcdata in place only through TransformManager placeholders until apply materializes ops/varnodes; failed doTrace leaves every op/varnode byte unchanged except cleared marks; buildStore/buildLoad read the spaceid constant by offset only (getSpaceFromConst); newIop placeholders share the affecting op across lane INDIRECTs; inheritIndirect propagates indirect_creation vs indirect_creation_possible_out based on the original input's indirect-zero flag (transform.cc:273-282). INDIRECT slot-1 annotation varnodes are projected through their true iop-space classification (si/k0, non-constant) on both sides: Rugra's constant_iop arm decodes the placeholder value back into the affecting PcodeOp and re-materializes it via new_varnode_iop, exactly as transform.cc:211-215 does through getOpFromConst; only the raw pointer offset (process pointer in the oracle, Arc pointer in Rugra) is omitted from the projection; every other annotation property (create index, size, flags, def-use) stays byte-compared.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: traceForward walks the descend list front-to-back incrementing the iterator before processing each op (subflow.cc:3923-3924); doTrace drains the workList LIFO via pop_back until empty or first failure (subflow.cc:4118-4123); processNextWork runs traceBackward then traceForward; buildStore/buildLoad iterate count 0..numLanes with little-endian lane i=count (big-endian numLanes-1-count), emitting the base pointer at bytePos 0 and an INT_ADD-advanced newUnique pointer afterwards; buildMultiequal creates one input placeholder set per op input (input-major) then one MULTIEQUAL per lane; buildRightShift/buildLeftShift scan src/dest lane pairs while the shifted window fits inside numLanes; createOps iterates newOps in creation order with the follow-fixpoint loop (transform.cc:665-680); createVarnodes iterates pieceMap ascending by create index then newVarnodes in append order (transform.cc:684-711); the Rust comparand snapshots the descend list once before iterating because placeholder creation cannot mutate it.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: bytePos starts at 0 per buildStore/buildLoad and accumulates description.getSize(skipLanes+i) per emitted lane, never resetting inside one build; restricted windows carry numLanes/skipLanes per workList node, with skipLanes inherited from restriction/extension outputs (subflow.cc:3953, 3607-3609, 3880); shift amounts are normalized from bits to bytes after the multiple-of-8 gate (subflow.cc:3805-3807); zero-lane constants are built per lane with description.getSize of the destination lane; minLanedSize gates checkForLanedRegister at every newUnique/newUniqueOut/newVarnode/newVarnodeOut, takes the 1000000 sentinel after setLanedRegGenerated and is reset (without clearing lanedMap) by Funcdata::clear; workList grows only from setReplacement of non-free non-constant varnodes.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: lanerecords are ordered ascending by whole size with duplicate-size sizeBitMask merged (architecture.cc:970-974); getLanedRegister binary-searches wholeSize equality and ignores the address (architecture.cc:290-306); lanedMap is keyed by VarnodeData::operator< comparing space index, then offset, then size descending (pcoderaw.hh:67); lane geometry comparisons are exact getBoundary boundary equality via restriction/extension (transform.cc:133-168); the typelock gate compares metatype order against the type.hh:79-99 descending enum (meta > TYPE_ARRAY rejects primitives, TYPE_STRUCT/TYPE_UNION reject separately) which Rugra mirrors as an explicit allow set {Array, Enum, PartialEnum, PartialStruct, PartialUnion} on Rugra-private TypeMetatype discriminants.

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus four verified overlays; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: One BfdArchitecture shell per case over immutable 34a3febf:examples/curl (GetStr for the map lifecycle, main_free/hugehelp/main_init plus glob_range/glob_set/glob_url/glob_word/match_url/my_fwrite/myprogress/next_url/progressbarinit for the trace cases); no followFlow and no Action pass; one synthetic BlockBasic per trace case; lanerecords replaced in-place with whole sizes 8 (mask 0x4) and 16 (mask 0x110); the typelock case builds its locked types through TypeFactory getBase/getTypeStruct/getTypeArray
analysis_options.placeholder_construction: Each trace case creates its integrated root op with unique outputs and constant inputs (PIECE at end, MULTIEQUAL at begin, INT_MULT/INT_RIGHT/INT_LEFT/INT_ZEXT/LOAD/INDIRECT at end, COPY roots for SUBPIECE-terminator/store/window/typelock graphs); STORE clobbers are three-input ops with a ram-spaceid constant, a pointer and a stored value; INDIRECT inputs carry newVarnodeIop annotations and are marked via markIndirectCreation(false/true); the typelock graphs lock free unique inputs to int4/empty-struct/uint1[4] via updateType(ct,true,false); LaneDivide is constructed directly (LaneDescription uniform 4/2 or 8/2, allowDowncast true only for the SUBPIECE-terminator and restricted-window cases), then doTrace and (on success) apply
analysis_options.case_matrix: arch lookup over merged size records; lanedMap miss/hit/suppress/preserve/clear; PIECE and MULTIEQUAL lane splits through doTrace+apply; INT_MULT default-branch rejection with zero mutation; SUBPIECE terminator (slice one byte out of a lane, allowSubpieceTerminator branch, subflow.cc:3934-3944); STORE split with written-pointer and free-constant-pointer paths plus INT_ADD advancement; LOAD split with base and advanced pointers; INT_RIGHT and INT_LEFT whole-lane shifts with zero-fill COPYs; INT_ZEXT half-register extension; INDIRECT splits with indirect-zero and possible-out inheritance; restricted skipLanes>0 window via multi-lane SUBPIECE restriction, traceBackward SUBPIECE extension, mid-window terminator at laneIndex==skipLanes and single-lane preexisting COPY; typelock gate rejecting TYPE_INT and TYPE_STRUCT while admitting TYPE_ARRAY
analysis_options.debug_macros: __TERMINAL__ only; OPACTION_DEBUG, CPUI_DEBUG and TYPEPROP_DEBUG absent
analysis_options.diagnostics: BfdArchitecture initialization diagnostics captured privately and excluded from the target API observation
analysis_options.normalization: Only raw unique-space offsets and process pointer values are omitted. Stable vN/oN encounter labels preserve all aliasing; opcode, SeqNum time/order, parent, create index, size, space index, constant value, def-use, lanedMap storage keys and record identity are byte-compared

observation_schema.format: Fourteen fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.op_projection: Exact block order, opcode, SeqNum time/order, dead state, indirect-creation flag, parent index, output identity and ordered input identities
observation_schema.varnode_projection: First-encounter identity, create index, size, address-space index, constant value (spaceid constants observed as the resolved space index :s<N>; INDIRECT slot-1 annotation varnodes observed through their true iop-space classification si/k0 with the raw annotation encoding — a process pointer in the oracle, an Arc pointer in Rugra — intentionally omitted), free/input/written flags, type-lock flag, indirect-creation flag, defining op and ordered descendant ops
observation_schema.count_projection: block ops, projected varnodes, alive/dead/all bank ops and total Funcdata varnodes
observation_schema.laned_projection: arch record: minimum size, ordered whole sizes, size-16 lookup whole size and bit mask, cross-space record identity, size-12 miss; map record: per-storage space:offset:size with record identity, whole size and bit mask in VarnodeData::operator< order, miss/suppress/preserve/reset/clear deltas
observation_schema.anchor_projection: doTrace result, root mark state after trace, failed-path before==after equality, replaced root dead state and detached output, reader SUBPIECE opcode and input count after apply, ram spaceid index, alive STORE/LOAD/INT_ADD/INDIRECT counts and flagged INDIRECT count, restricted-window reader states, typelock trace triple with lock-state confirmation
observation_schema.preserved: No order, alias, control-flow, identity or count field is normalized; only unique offsets and raw pointers are intentionally absent

arch_laned_lookup_minimum_identity.covers: getLanedRegister binary-search hit (size 16, mask 272), size-12 miss, getMinimumLanedRegisterSize over ascending whole sizes, and shared record identity across register/unique storage lookups

laned_map_lifecycle_ordering.covers: checkForLanedRegister miss (12) and hits (8/16/unique-8), VarnodeData space/offset/size-descending ordering, setLanedRegGenerated suppression through newVarnodeOut, Funcdata::clear preserving lanedMap while resetting minLanedSize, and clearLanedAccessMap

piece_split_apply_projection.covers: LaneDivide over a PIECE root with two 1-lane SUBPIECE readers: doTrace=true, marks cleared, both readers converted to preexisting COPYs, PIECE replaced by two lane COPYs, full op/varnode identity, SeqNum, def-use and bank-count projection after TransformManager::apply

multiequal_split_apply_projection.covers: LaneDivide over a MULTIEQUAL root inserted at block begin: two lane MULTIEQUALs land in reversed begin order, constant inputs split through the newSplit constant path (0x1122/0x3344, 0x5566/0x7788), full projection after apply

failure_zero_mutation.covers: INT_MULT defining op hits the traceBackward default branch, doTrace=false, projection before==after (zero op/varnode mutation), root mark cleared by clearVarnodeMarks

subpiece_terminator_path.covers: allowSubpieceTerminator=true terminating SUBPIECE branch (subflow.cc:3934-3944): a 1-byte slice at bytePos 4 of an 8-byte/2-byte-lane root fails restriction (bytePos+size off boundary), passes the lane-boundary and lane-bigger-than-piece guards, and the reader becomes a preexisting SUBPIECE over the lane-2 placeholder with newConstant(4,0,0) as its offset input; full projection after apply

store_load_lane_split.covers: buildStore (subflow.cc:3704-3742) over a written pointer (non-free) and a free constant pointer, including the free-non-constant rejection guard position, shared base pointer at bytePos 0, INT_ADD-advanced newUnique pointer with newConstant(ptrSize,0,bytePos) at bytePos 2, ram spaceid constant reproduction and little-endian lane order; buildLoad (subflow.cc:3753-3789) over a constant pointer with base/advanced pointers and per-lane outputs; both through doTrace+apply with full projection and alive-op counts

shift_zext_lane_split.covers: buildRightShift (subflow.cc:3800-3826) with a 16-bit shift over desc(8,2): three lane-to-lane COPYs from inVars+(startLane-skipLanes) and a zero-constant COPY in the most significant lane; buildLeftShift (subflow.cc:3837-3863) mirrored with the zero lane least significant; buildZext (subflow.cc:3875-3905) extending a 4-byte input to 8 bytes: two input-lane COPYs plus two zero-constant COPYs sized by description.getSize(skipLanes+inLanes+i); all through doTrace+apply with full projection

indirect_lane_split.covers: buildIndirect (subflow.cc:3681-3694) splitting two INDIRECT roots whose in(0) constants are marked via markIndirectCreation(false) (indirect zero) and markIndirectCreation(true) (possible out): lane INDIRECT count/order, inheritIndirect bit propagation, specialHandling re-marking of the materialized ops/outputs/inputs, iop sharing through newIop placeholders, and — since the TRANSFORM-CONSTANT-IOP-SPACE-0001 fix — TransformVar::createReplacement's constant_iop arm (transform.cc:211-215) materializing each annotation as a genuine iop-space varnode via the offset-based getOpFromConst (op.hh:249) resolution and Funcdata::new_varnode_iop; the projection classifies slot-1 annotations purely by space type (si/k0) with only the raw pointer offset omitted, so a const-space regression fails the byte gate; full projection after apply is byte-identical to the locked oracle

restricted_window_trace.covers: skipLanes>0 windows: a multi-lane SUBPIECE reader at offset 2 opens a 2-lane window at skipLanes=1 (setReplacement outSkip propagation, subflow.cc:3953); its traceBackward runs the SUBPIECE extension (subflow.cc:4046-4057) reusing the root split through getSplit with buildUnaryOp input offset (skipLanes-inSkip); its traceForward hits both a mid-window SUBPIECE terminator at laneIndex==skipLanes (the defined boundary adjacent to the NO_ORACLE negative-index corner) and a single-lane preexisting COPY with input offset outSkip-skipLanes==0

typelock_reject_path.covers: setReplacement type-lock gate (subflow.cc:3532-3538): TYPE_INT (metatype above TYPE_ARRAY in the type.hh:79-99 descending enum) and TYPE_STRUCT inputs are both rejected mid-trace with doTrace=false, cleared marks and before==after projections, while a type-locked TYPE_ARRAY input stays inside the allow set and splits normally through doTrace+apply; lock states confirmed via the /t varnode projection field

oracle_ub_lane_index_below_skip.covers: subflow.cc:3942 evaluates rvn+(laneIndex-skipLanes) with laneIndex<skipLanes, a negative index into the numLanes-sized newSplit array (transform.cc:484) — undefined behavior in the oracle with no defined observation to align to; Rugra conservatively refuses the split (see src/subflow.rs trace_forward annotation)

residual_union.detail: Ghidra subflow.cc:3942 evaluates rvn+(laneIndex-skipLanes) with laneIndex<skipLanes, a negative index into the numLanes-sized newSplit array (transform.cc:484) — undefined behavior in the oracle with no defined observation to align to; Rugra conservatively refuses the split (see src/subflow.rs trace_forward annotation). The adjacent laneIndex==skipLanes boundary is covered as MATCH by restricted_window_trace.
